content:
Earlier this year, Twelve South launched the brand-new Valet accessory, which they described as a "wireless charging stand and personal everyday carry storage tray."

Twelve South is now expanding the Valet lineup further, adding a smaller option equipped with MagSafe and Qi2.2 wireless charging, supporting up to 25W charging speeds.

The first-generation Valet announced earlier this year measures 7.5 inches wide, offering ample space to hold a phone, keys, wallet, glasses, and more. However, the new Valet has been significantly downsized to 4.25 inches.

Here's Twelve South's description of the Valet's premium design:

The Valet is designed first and foremost to be a beautiful home accent piece, and only secondarily a capable wireless charger. It combines warm materials with modern craftsmanship to create a calmer, more intentional silhouette that fits perfectly anywhere in the home—from the entryway table to the kitchen to the nightstand. The soft square charging pad echoes the architectural lines of the leather tray, while the weighted zinc alloy base keeps everything stable and tidy.

In terms of functionality, the smaller Valet has enough power to charge your iPhone, with an additional built-in USB-C port for conveniently charging another accessory at the same time:

  • Qi2.2 wireless charging up to 25W
  • Premium Nappa leather catch tray
  • Four adjustable orientations
  • Removable leather frame
  • Weighted zinc alloy base with built-in hidden cable management
  • Additional USB-C port supporting up to 10W wired charging
  • Includes 45W power supply and 1.5m USB-C cable

The 4.25-inch Twelve South Valet is available for order starting today at $129.99, offered in three color combinations. It's not cheap, but as a stylish and practical place to charge your phone and store essentials like glasses, wallet, and keys, it's absolutely worth it.
